name: ModelVariant760_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant760_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (after the delay a pulsing ring of quads with a flickering flash grows over the slot while its colours cycle, a spray of spinning lines bursts outward, then sparks rise and scatter before every spark fades out); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, resets the ring and spark state and packs three texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 1 during the spark phase, 2 at the end and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-777 and 874 images build it from the same source. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
